subject: LAG-1K: GROK-LAG-1K-C14 and C26 placed on D: (the two packages missing from the 43-category count)
body:
Two Lisan Al Gaib LAG-1K packages, approved by Ziggy, are now on D:. They are the two that were missing from the 43-category count. With them, From Grok has 26 GROK-LAG-1K-Cxx folders, and GROK-LAG-1K-G1 holds another 19 categories, for 45 in total.

1) D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\explorable_world\comfy\references\From Grok\GROK-LAG-1K-C14\C14-worm-rider\
   Requested: 22. Returned: 22 drafts (16 pass, 6 FAIL kept), from Z_1 and Z_5.
   MANIFEST: GROK-LAG-1K-C14\MANIFEST.csv  sha256 dc6591c7196c140507e4731a426d1ccf2ecec65ea809754d46181034d3e50183
   NOTES.md  sha256 9266f00dfca78fc68f583792d66411f91347e3e38598896dd2ec65ad6d44289a
   Every file listed in the MANIFEST was re-hashed on D:, 24 of 24 match.
2) D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\explorable_world\comfy\references\From Grok\GROK-LAG-1K-C26\C26-rig-cab-driver\
   Requested: 22. Returned: 22 drafts (16 pass, 6 FAIL kept), from Z_5. The folder also includes PRIME-C26-08-VIDEO-BRIEF.md.
   MANIFEST: GROK-LAG-1K-C26\MANIFEST.csv  sha256 f6a70d6d2ff534b7b8d66691f97fd7003f7e1d72a6a42c90836abe662a37f341
   NOTES.md  sha256 c899d3cd729b8db5ff37fa1f880b7ce2f7e1f2b79062f1de49fe346525a968a0
   Every file listed in the MANIFEST was re-hashed on D:, 25 of 25 match.

Each MANIFEST.csv has the columns path, bytes, sha256, role_character (Lisan Al Gaib), role_scene_setup (the category) and status.
Each NOTES.md starts with the requested and returned counts.
The layout matches the other packages (GROK-LAG-1K-Cxx\<category>\). Nothing existing was overwritten, moved or renamed, and C29-C40 and Downloads were not touched.
A ledger line was added to HaL's LAG-1K LEDGER.md on the box.
The scores are provider (Grok swarm) preliminaries. They are drafts only and are not accepted until Nova intake or Ziggy accepts them.
